E4Plus1.uk.description: Old Yeller Belly: Santa's Little Helper becomes Duff Beer's new mascot after he's banished from the Simpson home for failing to save Homer from a tree house fire. (S14 Ep19/22)

E4Plus1.uk.description: The Monkey Suit: Ned is horrified by an evolution exhibition and asks Reverend Lovejoy to promote creationism. So Lisa arranges secret evolution classes... (S17 Ep21/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer and Marge Turn a Couple Play: Struggling sportsman Buck Mitchell asks Homer and Marge for marital advice after seeing them share a passionate kiss. (S17 Ep22/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons

E4Plus1.uk.description: Replaceable You: When Homer loses his job to his eager new assistant, he teams up with Ned to reveal her evil past. (S23 Ep4/22)
